pralayakṣubdhaṃ utpātavaśādeva calantamadrimārūḍhaḥ puṣkarāvartako
megharājo yathā calitastathāhaṃ calita ityanvayaḥ

mugdhasya manasā iti pāṭhe
mugdhasyāpātaramaṇīyasya viṣayajātasya bhogābhyāsena jaḍenetyarthaḥ
jñasya tattvavido brahmākāraṃ ceta iva vitatamaparicchedyam
dāridryametya prāpya sthitā lalaneva sthitamiti śeṣaḥ
marumarīcyambubhiḥ purobhāge plutāni āplāvitāni kakummukhāni yatra

prāptavānityasya yatra sphuranti
tatreti pareṇa saṃbandhaḥ

ciraṃ līnaṃ svapakṣapuṭe gopitamāsyaṃ cañcupuṭaṃ yena tathāvidho vihago
yathā tathā
tataḥ pūrvāṃ diśaṃ prāptamadhupānāruṇāmiva dṛṣṭavāniti tṛtīyenānvayaḥ

tārakendukairavāṇāmupamānamānane
ityanenārthādānanamindornetre kairavāṇāṃ tattārake tārāṇāmupamānamiti
gamyate

kevalaṃ niṣphalavanakhaṇḍabhramaṇena cañcalaṃ jāticāpalyaṃ yathā syāttathā
viharanti tatreti śeṣaḥ

sā hi svāṇḍānyapi grasatīti kṣudhāyā
anucitakāriṇītvadyotanārtha viśeṣaṇam

tathācāhuḥ asya dagdhodarasyārthe ko na
kuryādasāṃpratam iti
